name: ExcelApplication
label: Excel Application
description: The Excel Application object containing the target worksheet.

name: ActivationMode
label: Activation Mode
description: Choose how to activate the cell: absolutely, relatively, or via named range.

name: Column
label: Column
description: The column letter (e.g., 'A', 'B') or number (e.g., 1, 2) of the target cell.

name: Row
label: Row
description: The row number of the target cell.

name: Name
label: Name
description: The name of the named range or cell to activate.

name: Direction
label: Direction
description: The direction to move from the currently active cell when activating relatively.

selectOptions.label: Up
selectOptions.description: Moves upward from the current cell.

selectOptions.label: Down
selectOptions.description: Moves downward from the current cell.

selectOptions.label: Left
selectOptions.description: Moves left from the current cell.

selectOptions.label: Right
selectOptions.description: Moves right from the current cell.

name: OffsetFromActiveCell
label: Offset From Active Cell
description: Number of cells to move from the current active cell when activating relatively.
